page.overview:
Who is Luco Bronc?

Luco Bronc, known as "the Killing Star," When his lover Rhy Cesca was assassinated by Geryon's troops, Bronc tracked him down on Sullust. He personally destroyed Geryon, avenging Cesca, then he rejoined Hawks and his Zero Company.

Bronc had white skin and eyes and white blond hair. He was sharp-tongued because of both their histories on opposite sides of the war.
